basis.imputation_method: Fill missing rows up to a full 15-market year at the observed bytes-per-row before target scaling, preventing HYPE partial-year coverage from lowering the estimate.

operation_model.source: Conservatively retain the previously frozen 28,000-partition R2 operation envelope even though Binance Vision bulk delivery reduces source HTTP pagination and the current pilot path may use fewer R2 state operations.

comparison_to_original_m1b_model.interpretation: The original M1B estimate remains a valid conservative frozen reference. The new estimate is based on a full-year-equivalent Binance pilot and is the preferred observed capacity calibration for Binance long-history planning.

caveats: This is a capacity model, not proof that 250 Binance USD-M markets have eight years of history.
Actual market listing and delisting coverage will reduce or change realized storage relative to a full-coverage envelope.
R2 free-tier usage is account-level; other buckets/projects can consume the same included usage.
Mark Price, Funding, Open Interest, SState evidence, reports and future derived datasets are not included in these trade-Kline bytes.
Cloudflare Workers, Workflows, Queues and D1 require separate cost gates.
